description_en: Fetches files from a cloud phone to Object Storage Service (OSS)
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic fetch-file --android-instance-id-list acp-34pqe4r0kd9kn0000 --source-file-path /data/a.txt --upload-type OSS --upload-endpoint oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com --upload-url oss://cloudphone-saved-bucket-example/received --region cn-hangzhou
name: FetchFile

parameters.help_en: A list of cloud phone instance IDs
parameters.name: android_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The path of the file or folder to fetch from the cloud phone
parameters.help_zh: 从指定的云手机文件路径拉取文件
parameters.name: source_file_path

parameters.help_en:
The type of storage service for the fetched file.

Currently, only Object Storage Service (OSS) is supported
parameters.help_zh:
保存拉取文件的存储类型。

目前仅支持的云端存储类型是OSS对象存储
parameters.name: upload_type

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for uploading files to OSS.

If the cloud phone and the destination OSS bucket are in the same region, you can use an internal endpoint to accelerate the transfer and avoid public network charges. For example, in the China (Hangzhou) region, use `oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com`. For a complete list of endpoints, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html
parameters.help_zh:
从OSS拉取文件的服务域名。

当云手机和OSS Bucket处于相同地域，域名可填写内网域名，加快传输速率，不产生公网网络费用，杭州为例： `oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com` 。具体的域名列表映射可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html
parameters.name: upload_endpoint

parameters.help_en:
The destination URL in OSS.

The destination bucket name must be prefixed with `cloudphone-saved-bucket-`. For example, `cloudphone-saved-bucket-example`. You must also create a folder in the bucket to serve as the destination directory. The `UploadUrl` must follow the format: `oss://<bucket_name>/<folder_name>`
parameters.help_zh:
从OSS拉取文件的云端地址。

可使用的OSS桶名，必须以“cloudphone-saved-bucket-”前缀的Bucket桶，例如“cloudphone-saved-bucket-example”，并创建OSS文件夹作为备份目录。UploadUrl的拼写规则是“oss://”+“桶名”+“/”+“文件夹名称”
parameters.name: upload_url

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token, up to 100 characters long, that ensures the idempotency of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。不超过 100 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

Data.description_en: An array of results, with one entry for each instance specified in the request

items.description_en: The result for a single cloud phone instance

AndroidInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the cloud phone instance

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the task created for this specific instance

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Provide this ID when contacting support for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求唯一ID，如果遇到问题请提供这个请求ID，由工作人员为您排查
